propertyNotes.insertionSlackMm: pilot_bound(cut) - engagement: how much deeper this end could be engaged before the member can no longer be rotated down into place. It is the binding constraint at a CLOSING end. At a TREE end the far end is free and the member slides on axially, so the same number is deeply negative and says nothing about that end — it is capped anyway, because its two terms are the engagement and the cut length.
propertyNotes.slotStartMarginMm: how far the socket starts BEYOND the worst thing it could foul at this node, over all four feature-pair types. It is the allowance that absorbs print tolerance, and it is the first thing a node pulled in to save material spends.
propertyNotes.engagementMm: how deep this end's pipe goes onto its spigot: the full stub at the 100 ends of the 50 spanning-tree members, which are slid on axially, and the pilot at the 332 closing ends, which cannot be.
